demos.name: Observability Lab
demos.description: Follow a log line from PingOne, PingFederate and Ping Gateway to a searchable, alertable store. Seeded mock logs, a LogQL-lite query box, three alert rules and a label lab that shows the silent failure when one relabel rule is missing. Real mode reads one loopback Loki, read-only.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7800). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7800 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Real: set OBS_LOKI_URL to a loopback Loki (for example the AI-DEMO2 observability profile on http://127.0.0.1:3100). Derived from the AI-DEMO2 monitoring stack (Alloy, Loki, Grafana); line shapes are illustrative and labelled UNVERIFIED. Catalog id D123.
